sloka: किम् कृतम् तव रामेण पापं पापे मयापि वा ।त्वं ममात्मविनाशार्थम् भवनम् स्वं प्रवेशिता ॥२-१२-८॥
transliteration: kim kṛtam tava rāmeṇa pāpaṁ pāpe mayāpi vā ।tvaṁ mamātmavināśārtham bhavanam svaṁ praveśitā ॥2-12-8॥

translations.english: Then Rama was conducting himself in relation to you as his own mother, for what purpose are you seeking injustice to such a person?
